scope: Only G02: organic life as intermediary between planetary influences and Earth in Gurdjieff's account as reported by Ouspensky. Not an account of G03, G04, or modern physics.

sources.work: P. D. Ouspensky, In Search of the Miraculous
sources.locator: Discussion of organic life as Earth's intermediary, commonly chapter 7 (edition-dependent)
sources.status: historical-source-reference; no independent textual re-audit in 014

sources.work: Gurdjieff Foundation of Hawaii: organic-life excerpts attributed to Ouspensky
sources.locator: Grass-covered field compared with a gathering of people

claims.statement: Terrestrial organic life mediates planetary influences to the Earth.
claims.epistemic_status: claim within the reported cosmological account, not verified astrophysics

concepts.label: Planetary world
facets: Source of the planetary influences in this account.

concepts.label: Terrestrial organic life
facets: Receives influences attributed to the planetary world.
example_variations: The same field occupied by a gathering of people
concepts.variation_limit: The excerpt describes different reception by these configurations, but does not identify physical influence classes or a biological mechanism.

concepts.label: Earth
facets: Recipient of the relation mediated through organic life.

relationships.requirement_scope: Only this represented mediation relation; no assertion that bare Earth receives no other influences.

interpretive_limits: Relations name roles in a reported cosmology, not measured physical transmissions.
No specific particle, frequency, wavelength, speed, energy budget or conversion mechanism is asserted.
The grass/people example does not posit exactly two literal influence species.
A bare-ground counterfactual would be a research control, not a claim about Earth's history or all physical forces.
Outgoing radiations to Sun, planets and Moon (G03) and lunar nourishment (G04) are deliberately outside this model.

time_semantics.domain_time: This model records relations and conditions; it specifies no measured delay, detailed process kinetics, or creation chronology.
time_semantics.presentation_time: The order of explanation may change independently of the asserted relationships.
time_semantics.manipulation_time: A future inspectable study may vary examples or remove the intermediary as an explicitly marked research counterfactual.
